# Financial Econometrics Practical Exam 2026

Student number: 24693197

This README contains and describes all code used in the analysis. Functions are stored in each question's `code/` folder (for example `Questions/Question1/code/`) and are sourced in the relevant section below. The write-ups (pdf, html or slides) are found in the `Questions/` folders.

# Setup

The project was created with `fmxdat::make_project()`. The question folders were created with Texevier's folder functions. The chunk below is not evaluated when knitting (`eval = F`), as re-running it would try to create the folders again.


```{r, eval = F}
# Project root:
fmxdat::make_project()

# Question folders (PDF Texevier):
Texevier::create_template(directory = "Questions", template_name = "Question1",
                          build_project = TRUE, open_project = FALSE)

# HTML Texevier (research report for Question 2):
Texevier::create_template_html(directory = "Questions", template_name = "Question2",
                               build_project = TRUE, open_project = FALSE)

Texevier::create_template(directory = "Questions", template_name = "Question3",
                          build_project = TRUE, open_project = FALSE)

Texevier::create_template(directory = "Questions", template_name = "Question4",
                          build_project = TRUE, open_project = FALSE)
```

The exam data (`Prac26_Data.zip`) was unzipped into `data/` in the root and the files used per question were copied into that question's `data/` folder. All `data` folders are excluded from Git in `.gitignore`.

```{r}
# Hide package messages and warnings in the knitted README; fix default figure size:
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)

rm(list = ls()) # Clean your environment:
gc() # garbage collection
library(tidyverse)
pacman::p_load("xts", "tbl2xts", "PerformanceAnalytics", "lubridate", "glue", "RcppRoll", "gt", "rmsfuns")
if (!require("fmxdat")) pacman::p_install_gh("Nicktz/fmxdat")

# Shared functions used across questions:
list.files('code/', full.names = T, recursive = T) %>% .[grepl('.R', .)] %>% as.list() %>% walk(~source(.))
```
